notes.title: RELEASE DATE CONFIRMED – GUILD OF DARKSTEEL IS LAUNCHING SOON!
notes.notes:
Greetings sellswords! I'm delighted to share the news that Guild of Darksteel has an official release date – the game will launch July 15th on Steam (and Nintendo Switch)! It will be available for a limited time with a 25% launch discount, so – if you haven't already – add it to your wishlist and you'll be alerted the moment it's available.

[previewyoutube=NBcJz5xXhUA;full][/previewyoutube]
Thanks for your support!

Matt | Digerati
